part.text:
Fixed. The one-line change in src/object.c:1665 (in `lookupKey`) replaces `server.current_client->cmd` with `server.executing_client->cmd` for the TOUCH exception of `LOOKUP_NOTOUCH`:

```c
if (server.current_client && server.current_client->flag.no_touch &&
    server.executing_client->cmd->proc != touchCommand)
    flags |= LOOKUP_NOTOUCH;
```

**Why:** When a no-touch client runs `EVAL`, `server.current_client` is the caller whose `cmd` is `EVAL`, so a `TOUCH` inside the script never matched the `touchCommand` exception and its lookups were suppressed with `LOOKUP_NOTOUCH`. `server.executing_client` (set in `call()`, src/server.c:3624) points to the client actually executing the sub-command (the script engine client with `cmd = touchCommand`), so TOUCH now correctly updates the last access time from scripts, while regular no-touch operations (GET/SET from scripts) still avoid touching.

Verified: `unit/introspection-2` and `unit/scripting` both pass.
